messages:
Meera (Support): P0 - multiple customers reporting increased 5xxs and timeouts against hosted inference endpoints. Started ~09:15 UTC after today's canary. Seeing lots of 503/gateway and 504s. Escalating to ops. @Lina please. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Canary deployment finished: service=api-router env=prod region=us-west-2 canary-id=c-20260316-0911 configset=release-2026-03-16-09:10
  changed_keys: default.prefetch_mode -> "v2" (templated)

Ben (SRE Lead): Confirmed spike in error rate in us-west-2: 5xx rate baseline ~3% -> 22% at 09:18. Most errors are gateway 503, some 504 timeouts. Traces show upstream inference worker returning 500 intermittently.

Lina (Ops Oncall): Rolling back canary now. Running rollout rollback command and pausing further traffic shifts. ETA ~2-3min. Pinging billing since some customers reported duplicate billing events.

Meera (Support): Customer repro from support ticket #14521: minimal repro curl pasted below (token redacted):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/completions \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-3","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 503 Service Unavailable
Headers: x-request-id: a1b2c3d4, x-upstream: api-router-9

support-bot: Attached recent logs from the gateway for x-request-id a1b2c3d4.

Carol (Infra Eng): Looking at logs: template engine replaced the feature key used by the routing code. The canary config accidentally set default.prefetch_mode to v2 at a global scope (mistagging in the config substitution step). Some workers expect the old prefetch path and hit a null-check leading to 500s. This matches the stack traces: "panic: nil pointer dereference in prefetch_selector.go:87".

Ben (SRE Lead): Reproduction steps (local):
1) Start api-router with canary config: 
   CONFIG_SRC=release-2026-03-16-09:10 ./bin/api-router --env=prod --region=us-west-2
2) Send traffic with header X-Canary-Tag: c-20260316-0911 (we simulate canary)
3) Observe 500 logs in prefetch_selector and gateway 503s after prefix cache miss

Carol (Infra Eng): Quick mitigation: revert templated config in config service and restart the routing agents on the canary cohort. Full rollback is safer; Lina is already rolling back. Also adding a hotfix to validation so config keys don't propagate globally without explicit scope.

Lina (Ops Oncall): Rollback executed at 09:23 UTC. Confirmed canary removed and traffic rerouted to stable. Running controlled verification now.

Ben (SRE Lead): Post-rollback metrics: 5xx rate dropping — us-west-2 now 1.4% at 09:27. Latency normalized. Marking incident as mitigated but keeping channel open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

Meera (Support): Notifying affected customers with apology + mitigation & steps to avoid retry storms. Creating support tickets for billing anomalies and attaching logs & x-request-ids.

billing-team: We saw a handful of duplicate charge attempts for jobs that timed out then re-tried. We'll open a customer credit workflow and pause ledger finalization for impacted accounts.

Ben (SRE Lead): Action items:
- infra: add template-scope linting and a canary config gating test (Carol)
- ops: update rollback runbook to include immediate billing notification (Lina)
- support: email templated notice + incident ticket (Meera)
- postmortem: create postmortem doc and include telemetry graphs and config diff (owner: Ben)

Carol (Infra Eng): Quick repro commands for devs:
```
# simulate canary config substitution that caused the leak
python tools/config_sim.py --template release-2026-03-16-09:10 --apply-scope global --dryrun
# then run unit that validates key scoping
python tools/validate_config_scope.py release-2026-03-16-09:10
```

Ben (SRE Lead): I'll keep monitoring for 2h and then transition to normal ops. Please add any observed customer ids and x-request-ids to ticket #INC-20260316-09 for the PM/fin team.

Meera (Support): Thanks all — I'll follow up with timelines for impacted customers and include repro steps so partners can verify.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed: canary-id=c-20260316-0911 -> state=rolled_back (09:25 UTC)

Lina (Ops Oncall): Confirmed stability checks green for primary endpoints. Closing active mitigation.

Ben (SRE Lead): Postmortem checklist: schedule RCA, add safer defaults in templating, and add an automated smoke test that runs the existing prefetch path against new config variants before promotion.

Meera (Support): Closing thread after tickets created. Will reopen if we see regression. :handshake:
